units.Distribuidora B2B de hostelería · 400 cl: B2B hospitality distributor · 400 customers · customer segmentation in Power BI
units.Las ventas estaban bajando, pero no esta: Sales were falling, but it wasn’t clear why.
units.La cartera de clientes crecía, pero el r: The customer base was growing, but revenue wasn’t keeping up. The sales team had the data, but no simple way to know which customers were still active, which were buying less often and which might be about to disappear.
units.Antes de pensar en captar más clientes,: Before thinking about winning more customers, we had to look at the ones already there.
units.Entender cómo estaba comprando cada clie: Understanding how each customer was buying.
units.Analicé los 400 clientes a partir de tre: I analysed the 400 customers starting from three very simple questions:
units.¿Cuándo compró por última vez? ¿Cuántas: When did they last buy? How often do they buy? How much do they spend?
units.Con esas tres variables construí un mode: With those three variables I built an RFM model to spot different buying behaviours and, above all, find where revenue might be at risk.
units.Tres variables para entender una cartera: Three variables to understand a customer base.
units.El modelo RFM parte de una idea bastante: The RFM model starts from a fairly simple idea: a customer’s recent behaviour says much more than their historical value on its own.
units.Los tres valores se transforman en puntu: The three values are turned into scores using dynamic percentiles instead of fixed cut-offs. That way, the segmentation adapts to how customers are really distributed and doesn’t depend on thresholds set by hand.
units.Clientes con una relación sólida, pero q: Customers with a solid relationship who are starting to show signs of losing activity.
units.Clientes con margen para aumentar su rel: Customers with room to grow their relationship with the company.
units.Clientes cuya actividad empieza a deteri: Customers whose activity is starting to deteriorate.
units.Clientes que necesitan seguimiento antes: Customers who need follow-up before their activity keeps falling.
units.Clientes que prácticamente han dejado de: Customers who have practically stopped buying.
units.El RFM está dentro del modelo, no separa: RFM lives inside the model, not apart from it.
units.Construí un <strong>esquema en estrella<: I built a star schema with Fact_Pedidos as the fact table and five dimensions: Dim_Cliente · Dim_Fecha · Dim_Producto · Dim_Comercial · Dim_TipoEstablecimiento.
units.Las puntuaciones RFM y el segmento final: The RFM scores and the final segment live in Dim_Cliente. That way, the segmentation can be crossed with the rest of the model to analyse it by area, sales rep, venue type, product or period.
units.El dashboard se construyó alrededor de c: The dashboard was built around four questions:
units.¿Qué debería hacer el equipo comercial c: What should the sales team do with each segment?
units.Esta última parte se convirtió en una ta: That last part became a table of sales actions generated directly from DAX using HTML, with no external visual.
units.Una página para pasar del dato a la acci: One page to go from data to action.
units.Power BI · DAX · Power Query / M · Esque: Power BI · DAX · Power Query / M · Star schema
A signal that didn’t show up in the total.
units.Este grupo concentraba una parte importa: This group accounted for a large share of revenue, but its recency had been getting worse for months.
units.No eran clientes que hubieran desapareci: They weren’t customers who had suddenly disappeared. They still had a valuable buying history, but they were buying less and less.
units.Ahí es donde la segmentación cambia la l: That’s where segmentation changes the reading: the problem stops being «sales are falling» and becomes «these customers need attention».
units.Dos segmentos. Dos situaciones completam: Two segments. Two completely different situations.
units.Clientes con un historial de compra impo: Customers with a significant buying history who were losing activity.
units.La recency había aumentado durante los ú: Their recency had increased over recent months while their historical spend level was still significant. It was a particularly interesting group for a reactivation strategy.
units.Los clientes más activos y rentables de: The most active and profitable customers in the base.
units.Su recency media era de solo <strong>14: Their average recency was just 14 days, a clear sign they kept up a frequent buying relationship.
units.El mismo dashboard que detecta clientes: The same dashboard that spots customers at risk also shows who is holding the business up.
units.Cálculo de Recency, Frequency y Monetary: Calculating Recency, Frequency and Monetary, percentiles, segmentation and generating the sales action table.
units.Separación entre hechos y dimensiones pa: Separating facts and dimensions to keep the model flexible and easy to analyse.
units.Tabla de acciones comerciales generada d: A sales action table generated inside a measure, with no external visual.
units.Cortes de segmentación adaptados a la di: Segmentation cut-offs adapted to how customers are really distributed.
units.Qué me llevo del proyecto: What I take away from the project
The hardest part wasn’t calculating RFM.
units.La fórmula es conocida. La parte interes: The formula is well known. The interesting part was deciding how to turn those calculations into a segmentation that made sense for the business.
units.Un corte fijo puede funcionar en un data: A fixed cut-off can work on one dataset and stop making sense when the customer distribution changes. That’s why I chose dynamic percentiles: the model adapts to the data instead of forcing the data to adapt to the model.
units.También me encontré con los límites de g: I also ran into the limits of generating HTML from DAX. It works in some cases, but it doesn’t replace a native visual once interaction or maintenance start to get complicated.
units.Al final, el proyecto me dejó una idea b: In the end, the project left me with a fairly simple idea:
units.Un buen análisis no solo tiene que decir: A good analysis doesn’t just have to say what’s happening. It has to help you see where to look next.
units.De «las ventas están bajando» a saber ex: From «sales are falling» to knowing exactly where to look.
